content.user_title: Optimize Revenue Operations and Lead Handoffs
content.value_statement: Disconnected lifecycle rules create slow handoffs and unreliable pipeline data. This skill designs scoring, routing, automation, and dashboard specifications for aligned revenue teams.
actual_capabilities: Defines lifecycle stages with entry criteria, exit criteria, owners, and service-level agreements.
Builds fit and engagement scoring models with negative signals, thresholds, and recalibration guidance.
Designs round-robin, territory, account, and skill-based routing rules with fallback ownership.
Specifies CRM workflows for handoffs, alerts, stage changes, stale deals, and meeting events.
Creates pipeline stage requirements and dashboard metrics for marketing, sales, and executives.
Adapts recommendations to HubSpot, Salesforce, Calendly, SavvyCal, and Zapier workflows.
limitations: Provides specifications and guidance; it does not connect to or modify CRM systems.
Requires business context and historical data for reliable scoring thresholds and benchmarks.
Platform examples may require adjustment for account tiers, custom fields, and current product features.
Does not replace legal, finance, or data privacy review for automation and deal processes.

use_cases.title: Redesign lifecycle handoffs
use_cases.description: Document shared stages, owners, SLAs, and recycling rules for marketing, sales, and customer success.

use_cases.title: Launch scoring and routing
use_cases.description: Create an initial lead scoring model and routing decision tree for a growing inbound program.

use_cases.title: Establish pipeline governance
use_cases.description: Define opportunity stages, required fields, approval rules, and executive metrics for consistent forecasting.

prompt_templates.title: Map our lifecycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Map a lead lifecycle for [company type] using [GTM motion]. Define each stage, entry criteria, exit criteria, owner, and handoff SLA.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with clear funnel definitions and ownership.

prompt_templates.title: Build a lead scoring model
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 100-point lead scoring model for [ICP] with [ACV] and [sales cycle]. Include fit, engagement, negative signals, threshold, and calibration plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn buyer characteristics and behavior into qualification rules.

prompt_templates.title: Design routing and automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design lead routing for [team structure] in [CRM]. Include precedence, capacity handling, fallback ownership, SLA alerts, recycling, and an audit log.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate assignments and follow-up across a sales team.

prompt_templates.title: Audit the revenue engine
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this lifecycle, scoring, routing, pipeline, and automation setup: [details]. Identify leaks, conflicting rules, missing data, risks, priorities, and measurable fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate an established revenue system and prioritize improvements.

output_examples.input: Create lifecycle stages for a hybrid B2B SaaS company with a four-hour MQL response SLA.
output: Stage: MQL. Entry requires ICP fit and demonstrated buying intent.
Owner: Marketing until assignment. Sales accepts or rejects within 48 hours.
Automation: Alert the assigned representative immediately and escalate after four business hours.

output_examples.input: Build a scoring model for a mid-market software company with a 70-point MQL threshold.
output: Fit: Company size, target industry, and decision-maker role contribute 45 points.
Engagement: Demo requests, pricing visits, and webinar attendance contribute 55 points.
MQL threshold: 70 points. Review false positives and missed wins each quarter.

output_examples.input: Design routing for named accounts, enterprise territories, and a general sales pool.
output: Priority order: Named account, enterprise territory, regional team, then round-robin.
Capacity rule: Exclude unavailable representatives and preserve assignment history.
Fallback: Route unmatched leads to the RevOps queue and alert the owner.

best_practices: Use historical closed-won and disqualified lead data before assigning scoring weights.
Agree on stage definitions and ownership before implementing CRM automation.
Pilot changes with a small segment, monitor exceptions, and recalibrate quarterly.
anti_patterns: Do not automate undefined stages or conflicting handoff rules.
Do not treat one engagement event as sufficient qualification without fit.
Do not launch routing without fallback ownership, capacity checks, and decision logging.

faq.question: Which revenue processes does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers lifecycle stages, lead scoring, routing, handoffs, pipeline governance, CRM workflows, deal approvals, data hygiene, and dashboards.

faq.question: Can it implement changes in my CRM?
faq.answer: No. It produces implementation specifications and platform guidance but does not connect to or modify your CRM.

faq.question: Which platforms are included?
faq.answer: The references include patterns for HubSpot, Salesforce, Calendly, SavvyCal, Zapier, and related revenue tools.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your GTM motion, ACV, sales cycle, current tools, lead volume, lifecycle definitions, pain points, and goals.

faq.question: How should scoring thresholds be validated?
faq.answer: Test the model against historical wins and disqualifications, review false positives, and recalibrate it quarterly.

faq.question: Does it support product-led growth?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes product usage signals, activation behavior, PQL considerations, and hybrid fit-plus-engagement scoring.
